work.title: Untitled (Planes, Chess, Targets) 1
work.description: Dense mixed-media collage layering multiple top-down and side-view warplane silhouettes with bullseye targets, compact discs, and chess pieces across a fragmented yellow, red, and white ground. Ink linework, painted shapes, and collaged paper elements overlap in a compressed, all-over composition with handwritten numerals visible along the lower edge.
work.composition: dense all-over layered planes and targets
